concept: Rainy morning in an old railway waiting-room lantern workshop. A fictional adult portrait subject compares silk ribbon with the button on a hanging coat. The camera sees her through glass with rail-canopy reflections, saffron fabric blur near the lens, and one narrow prism-distorted red-lamp outline at the right edge.
source: Agent-authored randomized concept; keyword meanings drawn only from requester-keyword-context.json and general knowledge before pack access.
pass_rule: Every all_of element must be visibly present in the same saved original image. Missing, ambiguous, or partial elements fail the keyword. Overall keyword success requires all three keyword rows pass.

all_of: Near-camera saffron fabric creates visibly defocused soft shapes at the left and lower edges.
The portrait face lies visibly deeper than that near layer.
The face and eyes remain sharp and readable.
false_substitutes: Only background blur behind the subject.
Flat color border lacking a nearer out-of-focus material.

all_of: The woman and her hand activity are visible behind one transparent window pane.
Recognizable railway canopy beams and overhead wire appear as reflected external content on the same pane.
Both transmitted interior subject and reflected external content coexist in the same image.
The central facial area remains legible through glass.
false_substitutes: An opaque face reflected into a dark window with no transmitted interior.
Background beams seen directly through a window instead of external reflections.
A double portrait or digital collage without a readable pane surface.

all_of: A narrow distorted slice is confined to the extreme right frame periphery.
The red lamp has a spatially displaced duplicate contour in that slice.
A restrained spectrum fringe accompanies the displacement.
The central face retains one coherent undistorted outline.
false_substitutes: Plain rainbow flare or colored haze without displaced contours.
Face fractured or duplicated across the center.
A red background object merely near the image edge.

supplemental_scene_checks: Coat is hanging beside the subject.
Silk ribbon visibly meets a coat button.
Open tin of numbered tags and lantern workshop cues.
Soft rainy window light and red indicator source.
reference_checks: Short dark bob and wispy center-parted fringe visible.
Soft cheek contours used as appearance guidance, without identity claims.
Subject presented as an unmistakably adult fictional woman.
candidate_evidence_rule: Record new pc_ candidates exposed in this arm pack, actual adopted candidate IDs, literal prompt evidence, and pixel observations separately. Do not force unexposed candidates.
